User_requests: Only focus on the reproduction of Fig. 2 (finite size scaling of D_L), whose caption reads 'Finite-size scaling of D_L for selected values of \theta...'. You MUST use ITensors and ITensorMPS packages. You may use the effective spin chain hamiltonian, and DO NOT define custom spin-1 boson operators. You ONLY reproduce results for \theta=-0.64\pi and -0.74\pi and ignore other parameter choices.
